name_reason: Name follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention and accurately reflects purpose: dispatch entry for spell_id 0xF (heal/buff variant-B family). The '0f' suffix is a meaningful spell ID (spell IDs span 0x00-0x23), NOT a Ghidra address residue (function address is 0x2211c, unrelated to 0x0f). 'variant_b' correctly distinguishes the heal-style dispatch path (fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast applying fd2_apply_heal_spell_to_target) from the offensive-A family. Consistent with sibling thunks 0d/0e/10.
purpose: Battle spell dispatch entry for spell_id 0xF (15): plays the status-effect SFX and a slide pre-cast visual effect, then forwards to the shared variant-B heal/buff dispatch worker with spell_id 0xF.
logic_summary: Stack-probe (__CHK 0x14), then fd2_play_sfx_with_handle(status-effect SFX handle table, sfx_id=0xB, repeat=1); fd2_play_variant_b_slide_pre_effect(8, 4); finally fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast(caster, 0xF, n_tgt, tgt_arr). In the binary the tail is implemented as a JMP into sibling fd2_cast_spell_0d_variant_b's shared tail (alt-entry label 0x21b0b), so there is no explicit RET; the src expresses the equivalent direct call. Differs from siblings only by SFX id usage, the slide pre-effect params {8,4}, and the spell_id literal 0xF.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_cast_spell_0f_variant_b(uint32 caster, uint32 n_tgt, uint8 *tgt_arr)

params.name: caster
params.semantics: Caster unit id; passed straight through to fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast as the casting unit.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches usage and matches sibling functions' param naming (caster). No address residue.

params.name: n_tgt
params.semantics: Number of target units; forwarded unchanged to the dispatch worker (target count).
params.reason: Clear abbreviation for num_targets, consistent with sibling functions. No address residue.

params.name: tgt_arr
params.semantics: Pointer to the array of target unit ids; cast to int and forwarded to the dispatch worker.
params.reason: Describes a target-id array, consistent with sibling functions. No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; the dispatch worker performs the spell application.

comment_original_issue: The function had no comment block above its definition, unlike sibling variant-B entries 0xD and 0xE which each document their slide pre-effect params and address.
notes: Body verified against decompile + disassembly: PUSH 0x14/__CHK, play_sfx(handle_table,0xB,1), slide_pre_effect(8,4), PUSH args + PUSH 0xF + JMP 0x21b0b into 0x21AD9's shared tail (no explicit RET). Xref 0x51d3d holds bytes 1c 21 02 00 = LE 0x0002211c (self), confirming this is spell dispatch table entry index 0xF (table @ 0x51d01 + 0x3c). Ghidra plate is detailed and consistent with src; left unchanged. Only the missing src comment block was added; no symbol/param rename needed (all deferred to Stage 2 regardless).
